# Framer

Framer is a Framer-inspired dark theme with minimalist black-and-white surfaces and vivid accent colors. Three accents can be selected, and the recorded description lists 150ms transitions, a fixed 280px property panel, a compact interface, mobile touch targets, built-in CSS snippets and compatibility with Dataview, Kanban, Calendar and Excalidraw.

![Framer screenshot](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/theviviana/Obsidian-Theme-Framer/HEAD/screenshot.png)
